body.title: Add securityPinMeetsFloor eligibility check
body.summary: Add securityPinMeetsFloor(registry: ModelRegistry, familyId: FamilyId, modelId: string, floorTier: TierName): boolean -- holds iff some family's own FamilyDefinition.tierDefaults[tier].model (by id or alias) equals the pinned model AND that tier's rank is >= the floor tier's rank. A pin matching no family's tierDefaults at any tier is unclassifiable and treated as below-floor (false). This is the ONLY link between an arbitrary pinned pair and coreFloor's TierName ranking, since CoreFloorGuard.applyCoreFloor compares only TierName values and has no notion of an individual model's capability.
acceptanceChecks: A pin matching its OWN family's tierDefaults at a tier at/above the floor -> true
A pin matching a DIFFERENT family's tierDefaults at a tier at/above the floor -> true
A pin matching a tierDefaults entry BELOW the floor rank -> false
A pin matching no family's tierDefaults at any tier (unclassifiable) -> false

tests.name: securityPinMeetsFloor: a pin matching its own family's tierDefaults at a tier at/above the floor -> true
securityPinMeetsFloor: a pin matching a DIFFERENT family's tierDefaults at a tier at/above the floor -> true
securityPinMeetsFloor: a pin matching a tierDefaults entry BELOW the floor rank -> false
securityPinMeetsFloor: a pin matching no family's tierDefaults at any tier (unclassifiable) -> false
